summary: Pitch Grand Designs and Your Home Made Perfect first as they rank highest for the brand. Ads should target DIY genre on Channel 4 and HGTV to reach ages under 25, 30 to 34, 35 to 44, leans female.

placements.why: A documentary about building dream homes that attracts viewers who care deeply about design and quality living spaces just like your customers
placements.send: Parachute bedding set, one queen size
placements.pitch:
Dear set decoration team,

Grand Designs showcases exceptional home design and we believe Parachute bedding would fit naturally in scenes featuring completed bedroom renovations or staging moments. Our premium linens could appear on a master bed during a final reveal or in a quiet moment where homeowners appreciate their new space. The product is free with no paid placement required and we can ship within a week. We admire how the show celebrates thoughtful design that transforms houses into homes. Thank you for considering this collaboration. Best regards, Parachute

platforms.name: Universal Ads (Comcast)
platforms.how: Self serve from as little as $100, with no minimum commitment. Target viewers of content genres, plus age, gender and location. Reaches NBCUniversal, Fox, Paramount and others.

platforms.name: Amazon Sponsored TV
platforms.how: Self serve with no minimum spend, for brands that sell on Amazon in the US. Runs on Prime Video, Twitch and Fire TV apps. Target by genre and audience.

ads.note: Self serve platforms sell genres and audiences, not single shows. These shows are why these genres were chosen.
setup: Open Universal Ads and start a new campaign. It is self serve, from as little as $100.
Audience: people aged under 25, 30 to 34, 35 to 44, leaning female.

Budget: start with $100 over one week, then keep what works.
